description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'parseOverrides' that uses TypeScript compiler API to parse a TypeScript/JavaScript source file, traverse its AST, and generate modified source code with comments inserted for classes and their members based on provided callback functions.

methods.name: parseOverrides
methods.description: Main function that creates a TypeScript program, traverses the AST, and inserts comments into source code based on class and member analysis.

methods.name: getIndentationAtPos
methods.description: Helper function to determine indentation at a specific position in the source file.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Recursive AST visitor that processes class and interface declarations.

methods.name: serializeClass
methods.description: Serializes class or interface nodes by inserting comments for the class and its members.

methods.name: visitProperties
methods.description: Traverses property and method signatures within class or interface declarations to insert comments.
